title: Implement arbitrary-constellation mapping and reference demapping
description:
Implement the correctness-first modem path for arbitrary complex constellations and arbitrary bit labelings. This path is the reference implementation used for uncommon constellations, research workflows, and fast-path validation.

## Background

The framework must support user-defined constellations rather than only standard square QAM. That requires validated construction, a scalar reference mapper, and a soft demapper that is correct across arbitrary labelings so specialized implementations can be checked against it.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] Users can construct a modem from explicit constellation points and bit labels.
- [ ] Mapping and hard and soft demapping round-trip correctly for arbitrary valid labelings.
- [ ] Reference soft-decision demapping matches brute-force or log-sum-exp expectations in tests.
- [ ] Invalid constellations or duplicate and incomplete labels are rejected with explicit errors.

## Notes

This story provides the ground-truth implementation used to validate the optimized Gray square-QAM path.
